about us
Shreeyash Electro Medicals

Shreeyash Electro Medicals is in to manufacturing New Born life saving devices since last 34 years in Pune with an established sales & service network all across India.

The manufacturing activity is carried in 3 facilities in Pune in an ISO 13485 certified premises.

Shreeyash was the First firm in India to manufacture:

  • Bubble CPAP in 2003
  • Neonatal Ventilator in 2004
  • High Frequency Oscillatory Ventilator in 2006
  • Conductive Patient Warming Blankets in 2013, and
  • A fully Automatic Human Milk Pasteurizer in 2017

Our Human Milk Bank Equipments

A Human Milk Bank is a facility dedicated to the safe collection, processing, and distribution of donated human breast milk. This milk is often given to premature or critically ill infants whose mothers cannot provide enough milk.

01
Milk Collection and Screening

Donations are carefully screened and tested for safety.

02
Processing and Pasteurization

Donated milk is processed and pasteurized to ensure it is safe for infant consumption.

03
Distribution

Processed milk is distributed to hospitals and neonatal units where it can be used to support vulnerable infants.

our innovation
Pioneering Medical Device Innovations

At Shreeyash Electro Medicals, innovation is at the heart of everything we do. For over three decades, we’ve been dedicated to developing pioneering medical devices that set new standards in neonatal and adult care. Our commitment to advancing technology is driven by a singular goal: to enhance patient outcomes and support healthcare professionals with state-of-the-art solutions.

read more
1
1. Bubble CPAP (2003)

As the first company in India to manufacture Bubble CPAP, we revolutionized neonatal respiratory support. This non-invasive system delivers continuous positive airway pressure to aid breathing in newborns, providing a critical alternative to more invasive treatments.

2
2. Neonatal Ventilator (2004)

Our Neonatal Ventilator, introduced in 2004, represents a significant advancement in respiratory care for premature and critically ill infants. Designed with precision and flexibility, it offers various ventilation modes to address the diverse needs of neonates.

3
3. High-Frequency Oscillatory Ventilator (2006)

In 2006, we introduced the only Servo Controlled High Frequency Oscillatory Ventilator (HFOV), enhancing our ability to manage severe respiratory conditions. HFOV provides rapid, small breaths to improve lung function while minimizing the risk of lung injury.

4
4. Conductive Patient Warming Blankets (2013)

Ensuring optimal body temperature is essential for newborns in critical care. Our Conductive Patient Warming Blankets, developed in 2013, offer controlled and consistent warming, supporting recovery and stability during medical procedures.

5
5. Fully Automatic Human Milk Pasteurizer (2018)

In 2018, we launched the Fully Automatic Human Milk Pasteurizer, designed to ensure the safe pasteurization of human milk. This innovation preserves the milk’s nutritional value while protecting against harmful bacteria, supporting the health and development of newborns.

6
6. Shreeyash 900 Adult Ventilator (2020)

The Shreeyash 900 Adult Ventilator, reflects our commitment to expanding our expertise into adult care. Launched in 2020, this ventilator features an Auto Mode for adaptive and precise ventilation. Clinically validated and certified for safety, it meets global standards for critical care. It was awarded the Best Ventilator in India and showcased our exemplary vision willingness to adapt to the current needs.

7
7. Bilicare Focus Patented Phototherapy System – 2021

In 2021, we introduced the Bilicare Focus, a patented phototherapy system designed to provide effective treatment for neonatal jaundice. This innovative system combines advanced LED technology with precise wavelength control, ensuring optimal therapeutic outcomes.

8
8. Bubble CPAP with Adjustable Amplitude (2024)

Our Purpose

At Shreeyash Electro Medicals, our mission is to enhance patient care with innovative medical technology made in India. We are dedicated to supporting healthcare professionals with advanced, reliable solutions that improve outcomes and streamline care.

Our Quality

Our facility is ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 certified and all our products are CDSCO registered and certified. We also ensure that our products undergo clinical validation and compliance testing, including EMI and EMC tests and IEC 60601-1 standards.

Our Technology

We embrace the latest technology to develop high-performance medical devices. Proudly Made in India, our R&D team integrates new advancements into our products to address critical healthcare needs.

faq
frequently asked questions

What quality standards does Shreeyash Electro Medicals adhere to ?

Our facility is ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 certified and all our products are CDSCO registered and certified. We also ensure that our products undergo clinical validation and compliance testing, including EMI and EMC tests and IEC 60601-1 standards.

What sets Shreeyash Electro Medicals apart from others?

Our 100% made in India products offer durable medical solutions with a long service shelf life. With offices in over 15 states, we ensure effective support and accessibility, bringing reliable healthcare technology closer to you.

How can I purchase products from Shreeyash Electro Medicals?

To purchase products from Shreeyash Electro Medicals, you can follow these steps:

1. Contact Us : Reach out to us directly via email at dragonfly.sushrut@shreeyashelectromedicals.com or by phone at +91 8956144212 . Our sales team will assist you with product details, pricing, and availability.

2. Visit Our Website : Browse our product catalog on our website. Once you've selected the products you're interested in, you can submit an inquiry through our contact form or directly request a quote.

3. Request a Demonstration : If you need a demonstration or more information about our products, our team can arrange a session to help you make an informed decision.

What support services do you offer for your medical devices?

We offer comprehensive support services, including technical assistance, troubleshooting, routine maintenance, and emergency repairs. Our dedicated team is available to help ensure your equipment operates efficiently.
